# SpinPickOnline

> SpinPickOnline (https://www.spinpickonline.com) is a free, high-performance web platform for fair and instant random selection. It offers interactive custom spinning wheels, 3D dice rollers, coin flippers, party bottle spinners, tournament bracket draws, and team randomizers. Powered by the Web Crypto API (`crypto.getRandomValues`) for cryptographically unbiased randomness. 100% free forever, no signup required, zero remote storage of participant names, touch-optimized, and embeddable.

For complete technical specifications, iframe embed snippets, and comprehensive documentation, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.spinpickonline.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Picker Wheels
- [Free Spin Wheel – Homepage](https://www.spinpickonline.com): Interactive random picker wheel with custom entry inputs, color palettes, sound effects, confetti animations, and instant results.
- [Create Custom Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel): Full-screen custom wheel creator supporting unlimited entries, bulk pasting (comma or newline separated), segment color customization, spin history logging, and unique shareable URLs.
- [Wheel of Names](https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel-of-names): Online digital name wheel spinner. Enter a list of names, spin to pick a random person, and remove selected winners with one click.
- [Random Picker Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/random-picker-wheel): Universal random choice wheel for names, items, choices, raffles, and giveaways.
- [Name Picker](https://www.spinpickonline.com/name-picker): Fair random student and attendee selector for classrooms, remote meetings, and team standups.
- [Name Spinner](https://www.spinpickonline.com/name-spinner): High-engagement visual spinning wheel for name-based prize drawings and icebreaker games.
- [Yes or No Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/yes-no-wheel): Instant binary decision-making spinner with configurable multiplier sets (2x, 3x, 5x) and YES/NO/MAYBE formats.
- [Random Choice Picker](https://www.spinpickonline.com/random-choice-picker): Multi-option decision wheel to resolve dilemmas and eliminate choice paralysis.
- [Picker Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/picker-wheel): Minimalist, distraction-free wheel selector for rapid decision making.
- [Decision Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/decision-wheel): Group decision maker for food choices, movie nights, task priorities, and daily dilemmas.
- [Randomizer Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/randomizer-wheel): General-purpose random item generator wheel.
- [Wheel Spinner](https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel-spinner): Canvas-based wheel spinner with physics-based inertia, deceleration, and sound toggles.
- [Lucky Spin Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/lucky-spin): Gamified lucky spin wheel for trade show booths, promotional campaigns, and reward programs.

## Interactive Games & Decision Tools
- [Flip a Coin](https://www.spinpickonline.com/flip-a-coin): 3D physics-based coin toss simulator for fair 50/50 heads or tails decisions.

- [Spin the Bottle](https://www.spinpickonline.com/spin-the-bottle): Virtual party game bottle spinner with realistic physics for truth or dare, party games, and circle decision picking.

- [Would You Rather Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/would-you-rather-wheel): Fun dilemma debate generator wheel with thought-provoking questions for parties and icebreakers.
- [Food Picker Wheel](https://www.spinpickonline.com/food-picker-wheel): Food and restaurant decision wheel (Pizza, Burgers, Sushi, Tacos, Salad, Pasta, etc.) to resolve group dining debates.
- [Color Wheel Spinner](https://www.spinpickonline.com/color-wheel-spinner): Random color generator wheel outputting vibrant palette colors and hex codes for artists and designers.
- [Random Letter Generator](https://www.spinpickonline.com/random-letter-generator): Random A–Z alphabet wheel selector for Scattergories, Wordle-like games, vocabulary practice, and classroom games.

## Technical Architecture & Embeds
- **Algorithm**: Cryptographically secure PRNG using `window.crypto.getRandomValues()`. Provides uniform discrete probability distribution: $P(E_i) = \frac{1}{N}$.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: 100% client-side execution. Participant names, entries, and results are processed solely within the user's browser memory or local storage. No data is transmitted to backend servers.
- **Bulk Import**: Supports newline-separated or comma-separated lists pasted directly from Excel, CSV, Google Sheets, or text editors with automatic deduplication.
- **State Serialization**: Wheels can be shared via base64url JSON serialization in the URL hash/query: `https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel?share=<encoded_state>`.
- **Responsive Embed**: Embed interactive wheels on any website or Notion doc with standard HTML iframe:
  `<iframe src="https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel" width="100%" height="650" style="border:none;border-radius:16px;max-width:800px;width:100%;" title="Random Picker Wheel"></iframe>`
